description: Source code for the 'runfn' package in the 'kustomize' kyaml library, implementing functionality to run configuration functions on resources, including containerized and exec functions, with filtering, sorting, and input/output management.

classes.name: RunFns
classes.description: Struct representing a set of configuration functions to run on resources, with options for input/output, filtering, container and exec functions, and execution control.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Runs the set of configuration functions on the resources, managing input/output and invoking filters.

methods.name: getNodesAndFilters
methods.description: Reads resources from directory or input, and prepares filters based on input, function paths, and explicit functions.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Aggregates filters from input annotations, function paths, and explicit functions.

methods.name: runFunctions
methods.description: Executes the pipeline of filters on the input resources and writes output.

methods.name: getFunctionsFromInput
methods.description: Scans input resources for functions annotated within.

methods.name: getFunctionsFromFunctionPaths
methods.description: Reads functions from specified directory paths.

methods.name: getFunctionsFromFunctions
methods.description: Returns explicitly provided functions as filters.

methods.name: mergeContainerEnv
methods.description: Merges environment variables for container functions from command line and config.

methods.name: mergeExecEnv
methods.description: Merges environment variables for exec functions from command line and config.

methods.name: getFunctionFilters
methods.description: Creates filters for functions, setting scope and working directory.

methods.name: sortFns
methods.description: Sorts function nodes so that deeper functions are run first.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes RunFns with default values and configurations.

methods.name: getUIDGID
methods.description: Returns 'nobody' or the current user's UID:GID string based on configuration.

methods.name: ffp
methods.description: Provides function filters, creating container or exec filters based on function spec.
